_comment: User-defined maintenance jobs for tekmerdb-cron. Add your own jobs here. The cron engine reads this file at startup — restart tekmerdb-cron to pick up changes. Fields: name (string), enabled (bool), cron_expr (standard 5-field cron), command (shell command), timeout_secs (default 60), on_failure ('continue' or 'stop').
